messages:
mira: Quick follow-up from the postmortem (INC-2026-211). I consolidated action items into epic RI-8210 so we can track owners and handoffs: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RI-8210. Need owners, JIRA links, ETAs, and RACI for each.

mira: Short list:
- graceful-degradation policy + test harness -> owner
- rollback playbook update + checklist -> owner
- noisy-alert dedupe + tuning -> owner
- repeat-incidents RCA (recurrence pattern) -> owner

andre: I can pick graceful-degradation policy and the test harness. Will add subtask and aim for 7 business days. @zoe can you review the test plan?

zoe: Happy to review. I'll add a staging verification checklist and a small synthetic traffic job. ETA for review: Tue next week.

mira: Proposed RACI for graceful-degradation: andre (R), mira (A), zoe (C), infra-team (I). Agree?

andre: Yep that works. I'll annotate the ticket.

runbook-bot: Created JIRA RI-8211 "Graceful degradation policy + harness" assigned to andre. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RI-8211

zoe: For the rollback playbook update, can we include a short communication template for SRE->Support->PM? That helped last time.

mira: Good idea. I'll own the playbook update and add the comms template. ETA: 3 business days.

runbook-bot: Created JIRA RI-8212 "Rollback playbook update + comms template" assigned to mira. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RI-8212

andre: I'll also add a biweekly checkpoint on the epic until we see two consecutive release windows with no recurrence.

zoe: I'll open the RCA for repeat incidents and tag it with 'monthly-spike' and 'kv-eviction' if logs match. Creating RI-8213 now.

runbook-bot: Created JIRA RI-8213 "Recurrence RCA: logs + synthetic" assigned to zoe. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RI-8213

mira: Please drop a quick emoji when your subtask is linked in RI-8210 so I can compile the actions table for Friday ops. Also add the owner-of-record field on each ticket.

andre: :white_check_mark:

zoe: :thumbsup:

mira: Thanks all — I'll share the tracker update after lunch today.
